words: a system to help me manage notes and insights from conferences ... uploads of presentations, transcripts of talks, summaries and take aways from sessions, key themes, and overall event reports
rule: One store per event: originals (slides and transcripts) untouched; a summary with takeaways per session; themes per event tracked across events by shared ids; one report per event

words: similar to Cortex, may be a sub-set, but should be discrete and independent in the same way VA-Analysis or ProductDB or Black-Book
rule: Its own repo and build; Cortex reads it through the Suite API only

words: I'd keep the whey stuff to what Alan said yesterday. He's deep in it, in a way Nick is not.
rule: Scope (clarified by Nathan the same day): the supply chain briefing on SANS Europe 2026 summarises Alan Johnstone's talk, so its whey figures are his. Not a general rule.

words: make sure the summary of talks are more actual summaries - and they include photos of slides where appropriate
rule: summary.md: a prose Summary under 220 words with no cites; at most 6 key takeaways; up to 4 Key slides shown as photos; every other figure kept in Detail; photo cites open the photo

words: I'm interested in all perspectives and all data is valid. However, when I asked for a summary for the supply chain team, I was specifically asking for a summary of Alan's talk. That doesn't mean only trust him for everything though
rule: Every speaker's data is a valid perspective. Where figures differ between speakers, show both with their sources and say they differ; never drop or silently prefer one. A briefing scoped to one talk uses that talk's figures.
